description: This file defines classes 'CurlWraps' and 'CurlWrapsImpl' that serve as an abstraction layer for cURL multi-handle operations, providing virtual methods for performing multi-handle functions and managing implementation details.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class defining virtual methods for cURL multi-handle operations, meant to be implemented by platform-specific subclasses.

classes.name: CurlWraps
classes.description: Singleton-like class providing static accessors for cURL multi-handle functions, with the ability to set a custom implementation.

methods.name: CurlWraps::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation object for underlying cURL operations.

methods.name: CurlWraps::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CurlWraps.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Performs a multi-handle operation to perform all scheduled transfers.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Reads information about messages from the multi-handle.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_poll
methods.description: Polls for activity on the cURL multi-handle.
